name: slideable
description: Build decks out of your own template library. The agent picks a layout and writes copy; it never sends geometry.

interface.longDescription: Slideable turns an outline into finished slides using a fixed layout library. The agent calls list_layouts, picks a layout id and supplies strings for that layout's named slots — position, size, colour, type scale and spacing stay owned by the templates, so a generated slide is identical to one built by hand. Every write is audited for overflow before it lands.
capabilities: Build a deck from an outline
Rewrite slides without touching the design
Translate a deck to Arabic with mirrored layout
Audit every slide for text overflow
defaultPrompt: Build me a 6-slide quarterly review for a Dubai cafe chain.
Read the deck "Q1 Review" and tighten every headline to under six words.
Make that deck Arabic and mirror the layout.
